name: mo-money
archetype: Directional maker on crypto Up/Down windows (three-wallet cluster: bosona, almach, mo-money)
headline: Rests bids on the side of BTC Up/Down windows it expects to win and gets filled below fair value. Real profit that barely depends on rebates, though it is shrinking, run by what looks like one operator across three wallets. But no public-data rule reproduces which fills it gets, and every public-data maker built from the same data loses money or is insignificant in the same windows.
mechanism: 89% of sampled fills are maker fills on-chain. BTC 5m is 57% and BTC 15m 27% of its volume, the rest hourly, 4h and ETH/SOL windows. Its profit is the directional residual ($96,917, residual win rate 58%); the locked pair spread is -$24,845. Shared transactions in 30 days: 6,876 with bosona, 6,750 with almach; about 80% of its markets are shared with the other two.

roc.detail: 1621%/month: 30-day PnL $84,639 on peak capital at risk $5,222; counting the on-chain collateral too ($40,546), at least 185%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 89% maker fills (95% CI 84%-93%), 77% of USDC

match.detail: BTC 5m directional maker: stratified AUC 0.497 vs rotation null 0.504 (max 0.603), p=0.52; rule flags 36% of the wallet's decisions at 1.1x the base rate; BTC 5m spot-reactive maker: stratified AUC 0.564 vs rotation null 0.501 (max 0.574), p=0.045; rule flags 22% of the wallet's decisions at 3.4x the base rate; BTC 15m directional maker: stratified AUC 0.506 vs rotation null 0.490 (max 0.584), p=0.34; rule flags 33% of the wallet's decisions at 0.9x the base rate; BTC 15m spot-reactive maker: stratified AUC 0.471 vs rotation null 0.522 (max 0.617), p=0.91; rule flags 10% of the wallet's decisions at 2.4x the base rate; BTC 5m latency taker: stratified AUC 0.523 vs rotation null 0.540 (max 0.741), p=0.58; rule flags 0% of the wallet's decisions at 0.0x the base rate

backtest.detail: public-data directional maker, BTC 5m strict -13.5% (5,973 fills, p(profit)=1.00); first-in-queue bound -12.8% (6,488 fills, p(profit)=1.00); BTC 15m strict -18.8% (3,057 fills, p(profit)=0.99); spot-reactive maker at 2 s, 5m strict -6.0% (266 fills, p(profit)=0.88); at-touch -4.1% (370 fills, p(profit)=0.88); 15m strict at 3 s +1.1% (179 fills, p(profit)=0.43); fixed-price resting bids (0.05-0.40, either side, no data) -81% to -45% on the same TEST windows; reviewer market-anchored, spot-gated and tape-dip makers: none significant, most lose; its own maker fills in the same windows +3.2% on 5m (p=0.26), +4.7% on 15m (p=0.37)

replicable.detail: every public-data maker version is adversely selected at the latencies a normal connection allows (>= 2 s), even with first-in-queue fills; the wallet's edge points to faster prices than public 1-second data and queue priority. Rebates are not the issue: observed taker-rebate tier Gold (18% of fees); 30-day PnL at the 0% tier $81,999, Gold $84,622, Diamond $88,411, Obsidian $89,285

persistence.detail: significant decline inside the last 30 days, last 15 vs prior 15 (p=0.046). [last 30 days p=0.002; decline vs earlier p=0.83; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.046; trend p=1.00] Its 30-day blocks fell from $154k to $146k, $110k and $85k; A1 had rejected it only because of dormant weeks before it started trading (fixed).

reasons: No public-data rule reproduces which passive fills it gets beyond a small association.
Every public-data maker version loses or is insignificant in the same held-out windows, including first-in-queue bounds.
Appears to be one operator across three wallets.
corrections: Its own held-out maker-fill returns changed after the tape-pagination fix (the earlier figures missed fills in dense seconds).
The match test now uses the rotation null; results that were 'at chance' under the old null are reported with the corrected statistic.
First evaluated in this round: it failed A1 before only because dormant weeks counted as losing weeks.
